ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation and financial intelligence framework), as amended by Law 1121 of 2006; Decree 830 of 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB); Commercial Code Decree 410 of 1971 (Articles 86-115); Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Law 1437 of 2011 (Administrative Procedure Code); Law 319 of 1996 (ratification of the Hague Apostille Convention); Decree 1069 of 2015 (registry and RUES framework).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution or board/shareholder minutes of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or corporate registry in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: General or special power of attorney granted by the foreign shareholder to the Colombian incorporator or local attorney
Certificate of existence and legal representation of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry or chamber of commerce in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation of all foreign-language corporate documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official translator authorized by the Colombian Ministry of Justice and the competent language institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization and statutory translation certification per Commercial Code Article 251

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport and proof of identity of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if origin is a Convention member state; otherwise Consular Legalization by a Colombian consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders and UBOs against the Colombian UIAF restricted lists and Consejo de Seguridad Nacional lists, the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU autonomous sanctions lists, and the DIAN tax-lien and public-debtor registry. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) as defined by the UIAF Guidelines and FATF Recommendation 12 must be flagged, and enhanced due diligence (EDD) measures including source-of-funds verification must be implemented for PEPs, PEP family members, and close associates. All screenings must be documented and retained for at least ten years per AML record-keeping rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social - RUES (www.rues.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin-script characters; Spanish is the statutory language, but foreign-language words (including English) may be used provided the name ends with the mandatory type indicator 'S.A.S.' or the full phrase 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'. No statutory transliteration is required; however, the proposed name must be distinctive and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name in the national index of names. Names that can be interpreted as misleading as to the company's nature, scope, or public entity status are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In case of rejection by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición within 10 business days of notification pursuant to Law 1437 of 2011, and may subsequently file an optional recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC). If rejection is caused by similarity with an existing registered name, the applicant may alter the name and resubmit through the RUES portal. The initial name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may be renewed once for an additional 30-day period upon payment of the applicable chamber tariff.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a low-risk digital business (stock photography and generative visual assets) provided the company designates a physical address within the jurisdiction of the constituent Cámara de Comercio where legal notices (notificaciones judiciales), corporate books, and accounting records are maintained. A virtual-office arrangement does not exempt the S.A.S. from the obligation to keep books and records at the registered address or to respond to official correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - 3% to 5% annual probability for a non-licensed ISIC 7420 digital service activity; unannounced on-site inspections are primarily reserved for sector-supervised businesses (financial, insurance, mining, health, utilities) and foreign-exchange or customs audit triggers. The stock photography platform does not currently present an elevated inspection profile.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation (homologación de nombre) through RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per chamber of commerce fee schedule (Estatuto Único de Registro)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the S.A.S. incorporation minuta (private document) and corporate bylaws
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard single-shareholder S.A.S. incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille of foreign corporate documents (3 documents), including notary and government fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary of origin and Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Apostille tariff per document (approximately USD 15 per document) in the country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents (official translator)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per certified translation page-set (approximately USD 25-30 per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mercantile registry registration fee (matrícula mercantil) and inscription of the incorporation document
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory variable tariff based on company assets; lowest-tier rate for a micro-enterprise S.A.S.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation UBO registry analysis and RUB (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) filing preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for UBO identification, PEP screening, and RUB submission support

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: DIAN pre-RUT consultation and tax classification assessment for ISIC 7420
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Included at no incremental charge; standard pre-registration advisory covered in attorney fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-48; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 98-372; Ley 222 de 1995; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (registro mercantil unificado)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social principal through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), under the regulatory oversight of the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (private incorporation instrument and by-laws); elevated to public deed before a Notaría only if real-property contributions are made
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the full authorized capital must be subscribed at incorporation, but payment may be deferred under the terms fixed in the by-laws. No mandatory escrow account requirement. The S.A.S. may be formed with one share of nominal value greater than zero.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution — Resolved unanimously at the initial shareholders' meeting acting as governing body: (1) to approve the subscription of shares representing the full authorized capital, with the payment method, instalments and valuation for each subscriber as fixed in the by-laws; (2) to adopt the registered corporate domicile and principal office as the address set out in the by-laws; (3) to appoint [name] as legal representative, [name] as alternate legal representative and [name] as compliance secretary; (4) to authorize the legal representative to execute registration before the Chamber of Commerce, obtain the NIT, open bank accounts and file municipal licences; and (5) to ratify the by-laws as the sole governance statute of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Search and Homonymy Certificate (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal — Virtual Registry Desk, RUES portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES virtual portal, create a user profile, and submit the proposed corporate name (razón social) with up to three alternative names. The chamber cross-checks the proposed name against the national commercial registry in real time. Upon confirmation, pay the COP search fee electronically and download the homonymy certificate of exclusivity, valid for 30 days, reserving the corporate name.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name with two alternative names
Identification document of the requesting incorporator
Digital payment receipt of the homonymy search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If homonymy is detected, file a new alternative name immediately; if the 30-day reservation expires, re-submit a fresh name-availability request without substantive re-review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Incorporation Instrument and S.A.S. By-laws (Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Shareholders' private execution; Notaría del Círculo of the registered domicile only when real-property contributions require public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation instrument containing the by-laws under Law 1258 of 2008, including full subscriber identification, share subscription, capital payment instalments, governance structure, fiscal year end, and dispute-resolution and liquidation rules. Obtain wet signatures or e-signatures of all subscribing shareholders. If real estate is contributed, notarize the instrument as a public deed and register the property transfer in the public instruments registry.
required_dossiers: Private incorporation instrument and by-laws
Identification documents of all subscribing shareholders
Legal representative acceptance forms
Notarial public deed if real-property contributions exist
Marital asset consent documents where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct omitted or invalid statutory clauses (quorum, nominee share rules, arbitration, liquidation), re-sign the rectified instrument with unanimous consent, and re-tender the corrected version for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing at the Chamber of Commerce and Legal Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social principal — Subdirección de Registro Mercantil / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation instrument, homonymy certificate and DIAN pre-RUT to the chamber registry desk. The chamber officer verifies legal compliance, issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, assigns the commercial registration number, and collects the registry registration tax (0.7% of subscribed capital, capped) plus unified registration fees. Legal personality accrues on the registration date.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation instrument and by-laws
Valid homonymy certificate
Pre-RUT assigned by DIAN
Identification and address evidence of the legal representative
Proof of payment of registration fee and registry tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber issues a formal 'requerimiento', cure the flagged clause within ten business days, pay any corrective tariff, and resubmit through the virtual corrective entry without losing the registration priority date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT Registration and Beneficial Ownership Filing (Registro Único Tributario / Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Muisca online portal (muisca.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the temporary NIT from the pre-RUT, log into the Muisca module and complete the definitive RUT form, confirming CIIU code 7420, principal address, contact details and tax classification (income tax, VAT and withholding agent status as applicable). Upon acceptance, download the definitive RUT. Subsequently file the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF) with the identity of each final beneficial owner and control level, and keep the registry updated annually.
required_dossiers: Chamber commercial registration certificate
Incorporation by-laws
Passport or cédula of the legal representative
Proof of registered-office address
Beneficial ownership questionnaire for each natural-person shareholder and controller
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify RUT inconsistencies via the online corrective RUT form; if the RBF filing is questioned, supplement the missing ownership-ratio data within the DIAN-granted term and acknowledge any applicable late-filing fine.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capital Contribution Legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank of the company's choice (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA) — Corporate Account Opening Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, NIT/RUT, by-laws and shareholder identification to the bank's corporate desk. Complete anti-money-laundering KYC forms, including the transactional profile for Stripe and PayPal e-commerce collections and any international remittances. Deposit the paid-up portion of the subscribed capital and issue the accounting receipt. Unpaid balances remain receivable per the by-laws; no escrow account is required.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT and NIT certificate
Identification documents of shareholders and legal representative
Lease or ownership proof of the registered office
AML/KYC profile and expected transaction volume for digital payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries cross-border digital subscription patterns, supplement the KYC file with the e-commerce business plan and by-laws provisions on foreign currency and online sales, then re-submit the account application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Calibration (PILA and Social Security) and Municipal Economic-Activity Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social — PILA portal (Mi Planilla); Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda / Planeación of the municipal district
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. as a new employer in the PILA integrated contribution system, selecting the occupational-risk insurer (ARL), pension administrator (AFP) and health entity (EPS), and declare the first payroll contributions. Simultaneously file the municipal Registro de Actividades Económicas and obtain the land-use compatibility certificate (Certificado de Uso del Suelo) confirming that CIIU 7420 digital intermediation requires no physical manufacturing permit.
required_dossiers: NIT and chamber registration certificate
Lease contract of the registered office
PILA employer registration forms
Fire-safety concept issued by the fire brigade
Municipal economic-activity and land-use forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality objects to the zoning classification, submit the CIIU 7420 digital-service description and an operational plan showing no on-site retail or physical production, and request reclassification to the virtual-services activity code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Official Books and Digital Data-Protection Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio — Registro de Libros (RUES); Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) — Data-Protection Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the corporate books (shareholder register, board-meeting minutes book, accounting journal and inventory book) to the chamber for stamping and foliation within the first 30 days of legal existence. Adopt the privacy policy under Law 1581 of 2012, file the database authorization before the SIC, and record the marketplace Terms of Use, photographer contributor agreements and an AML manual applicable to Stripe and PayPal collections. Certify digital bookkeeping continuity for tax purposes.
required_dossiers: Official corporate books for stamping and foliation
Privacy policy and SIC database registration form
Terms of Use and licensing agreement templates
Photographer contributor agreements
Digital payments AML manual and e-commerce policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber rejects the book formats, re-issue the books with certified serial numbering and digital-watermark foliation; if the SIC questions database-processing terms, amend the privacy annex and re-file in the registry within ten business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for CIIU 7420 (stock-photo and AI-generated visual-asset digital intermediation); municipal fallback authority: Secretaría Distrital de Planeación for land-use certification
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or manufacturing operating permit required; only the municipal Certificado de Uso del Suelo and Registro de Actividades Económicas apply to a digital-service office

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — digital, e-commerce and photographic-asset intermediation services are not listed in Annex I of Decreto 1076 de 2015; no EIA study, registration or environmental license is required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no wastewater or VOC emission sources; general urban standards apply: noise limits under Resolución 0627 de 2006 for electronic equipment; electronic-waste (RAEE) management under Decreto 284 de 2018; waste segregation under Resolución 2184 de 2019

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Annual fire-safety technical concept from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; structural sufficiency certificate for occupied office floors and server racks; occupational health and safety (SGSST) registration with the Ministerio del Trabajo; ARL workplace-condition report covering ergonomics, lighting, and electrical installations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After commercial registration of the S.A.S. in the Cámara de Comercio, the legal representative must file the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application with DIAN before starting taxable activities. Filing can be completed online through the MUISCA platform or at a DIAN assistance point using the digital certificate of the legal representative or a Colombian attorney-in-fact under a notarized special power of attorney. DIAN assigns the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT), which serves simultaneously as income tax ID, VAT ID, and customs ID. A non-resident foreign entity requiring a Colombian tax identification for invoicing, withholding, or investment may also obtain an NIT/RUT through a Colombian fiscal representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: There is no Colombian 'check-the-box' election for foreign tax classification; an S.A.S. is always a Colombian taxpayer at the entity level. Elective regimes available include the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (RST) for eligible SMEs subject to turnover and activity limits, and optional consolidated taxation for Colombian corporate groups under Article 132 of the Tax Code. Anti-hybrid rules restrict deduction of hybrid mismatch payments, but no pass-through election is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary turnover threshold for corporate entities. Any S.A.S. engaged in taxable transactions must register as an IVA responsible party in the RUT before operations. For natural persons, a non-responsible regime applies when annual gross income is below 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 164 million for 2024), but this exemption does not apply to companies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: DIAN Resolution 165 of 2023 and prior regulations mandate electronic invoicing ('factura electrónica de venta') for all IVA-responsible taxpayers. Invoices are generated in XML, transmitted in real time to DIAN or an authorized technology provider, validated by DIAN, and returned with a 'validada' status. Each invoice must contain a unique DIAN validation code (CUFE/CUNE) and a QR representation; integration through DIAN web services or the authorized provider's API is compulsory for billing software. This digital validation operates as fiscal clearance/stamping. Supporting documents ('documento soporte') must be issued for transactions that are not subject to invoice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and certain services qualify as excluded from IVA (zero-rated). For services, including digital stock photo licensing and generative visual asset subscriptions, the service must be supplied to a person without residence or domicile in Colombia, must be used or exploited exclusively outside Colombia, and the consideration must be received from abroad. The exporter has the right to discount input VAT and to claim a refund of the resulting positive balance through DIAN.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Commercial invoice issued to the non-resident client evidencing the asset license, subscription, or generative service and the consideration received
Validated electronic sales invoice (factura electrónica de venta) accepted by DIAN, containing the CUFE/CUNE code
Customs Export Declaration (declaración de exportación/DEX) and customs authorization for physical goods; for digital services, the export service contract or license agreement and proof of provision
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or equivalent transport document for physical exports

Inward Remittance Certificate / Certificate of Foreign Exchange Reintegration (certificado de reintegro de divisas or declaración de cambio por servicios) issued by a Colombian authorized financial intermediary
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN subjects export-based VAT refunds to automated risk-scoring and documentary verification. If the documentation does not prove the export nature, the non-resident status of the counterparty, or the actual receipt of funds from abroad, the refund may be denied, blocked, or retrospectively clawed back with default interest and a penalty for 'inexactitud' under Article 647 of the Tax Code, which can reach up to 200% of the improperly refunded amount. Foreign exchange reintegration violations may also be penalized by Banco de la República, and intentional tax evasion may trigger criminal prosecution under Articles 434A-434C of the Tax Code, including custodial penalties. The general statute of limitations for DIAN to verify annual returns and refunds is five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Banrep) and the Financial Superintendence of Colombia (SFC) as supervisory regulator.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia has a managed (partial) convertibility regime. Current-account transactions, including service exports and royalty income, are freely convertible and can be channeled through the foreign exchange market without prior approval, subject to mandatory reporting and the four-month collection timeline. Capital-account operations are controlled and must be registered with Banco de la República. Foreign direct investment (FDI) must be registered using Form 4 (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales). Profit remittance to foreign shareholders is permitted only after the FDI registration is valid and a 'Certificado de Reintegro de Utilidades' is produced; such remittances attract the statutory remittance tax (currently 12% under Law 2277/2022). The principal non-tariff hurdles are mandatory conversion of export-of-services proceeds to Colombian pesos, the four-month reintegro period, and the prior FDI registration requirement for dividends.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For exports of services, 100% of foreign-currency proceeds must be collected and sold into the official foreign exchange market (i.e., an authorized bank) within four (4) months from the earlier of service provision or contractual due date. A 'Declaración de Cambio' must be filed with the local bank upon collection. Non-compliance results in a penalty of 5% of the outstanding unsettled amount for each month or fraction, plus interest. Extensions are possible only in exceptional facts, but digital platform receipts are routinely inspected, so strict adherence is expected.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency COP/USD, with trade finance and FX desk)
Operational Account (COP corporate checking with cross-border remittance integration)
Capital Escrow Account (for FDI compliance and investor funds in custody)
Operational Account (standard corporate current account, suitable for payroll and payables)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Mercury) are not authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediaries and cannot serve as the principal repository for service-export proceeds. Their use as payment-orchestration rails for disbursements (e.g., royalty payouts to foreign contributors) is feasible provided the entity independently meets the Banco de la República channeling and registration requirements. Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary operations, Low for primary treasury and dividend repatriation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence (or a local notarized proxy) is mandatory. Colombian banks require at least one legal representative or an attorney-in-fact to appear in person at a local branch to sign account documents and undergo the compliance interview. Remote opening is not generally permitted for corporate S.A.S. accounts; at most, the bank may use a video-call pre-validation before the in-branch appearance. For foreign directors, the power of attorney must be apostilled under the Hague Convention, translated into Spanish by a certified translator, and the named Colombian proxy must attend the in-person interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed S.A.S. with 100% foreign shareholder and no local operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: (i) Company certificate of incorporation and 'Certificado de Cámara de Comercio' dated within 30 days; (ii) valid RUT (tax registration); (iii) apostilled notarized copies of foreign shareholder passports; (iv) business plan and audited financial projections for first 12 months; (v) executed service contracts or platform agreements with Stripe/PayPal; (vi) descriptive ISIC 7420 activity statement and source-of-revenue explanatory memorandum; (vii) undertaking to provide periodic transaction manifests.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High volume of low-value cross-border micro-royalties from various online stock-photo/licensing platforms.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: (i) Six-month payout reports from Stripe/PayPal and any raw licensing logs; (ii) a compliance protocol for timely submission of 'Declaración de Cambio' and monitoring of the four-month reintegro deadline; (iii) sample invoices and commercial license contracts; (iv) exporter services registration certificate if applicable; (v) copy of the KYC/KYB policies to be applied to platform content contributors; (vi) delegation letter appointing a compliance officer and authorized bank representatives.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign-source capital injection whose provenance may be questioned (private entities, family wealth).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: (i) Bank reference letter from the source bank in the shareholder's jurisdiction; (ii) declaration of source of funds (legal origin) in Spanish, notarized and apostilled; (iii) audited financial statements or tax returns of the investing entity for the last two years; (iv) evidence of the transaction chain (SWIFT MT103 with correct purpose code); (v) simultaneous or pre-registration of Form 4 with Banco de la República; (vi) sworn undertaking as to the absence of political exposure and consent to bank verification charges.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For equity injection by a foreign shareholder, the funds must be remitted to the local bank using an international SWIFT MT103 with the correct purpose code (typically 'FIN.INV/EQ' or the bank-assigned code for foreign direct investment) and the recipient's NIT and account number. Upon receipt, the bank countersigns the exchange declaration and issues an investment certificate; within 12 months from the contribution date, the company must file Form 4 ('Registro de Inversiones Internacionales') with Banco de la República. Until registration, the deposit is held in a 'capital escrow' sub-account or a restricted account; after registration, the funds are reclassified as equity, enabling future profit remittance and capital repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary outbound clearing rail for settling royalties, licensing fees, and global content contributors is a standard SWIFT MT103 wire transfer submitted via the local bank's corporate banking interface. For large software procurement or acquisition of AI infrastructure, the bank can issue an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (LC) at sight under UCP600, confirmed by the beneficiary bank. All trade settlement payments must be declared in the 'Declaración de Cambio' under the corresponding service-import exchange concept number, and applicable withholding taxes (RETEIVA, RETEFUENTE) must be discharged. For recurring micro-payouts, batch-processing through SWIFT service bureaus or an RPA-driven file upload to the bank is acceptable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Delivery forward contracts (FX forwards) for up to 24 months with authorized local banks or registered foreign counterparties.
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) in USD/COP, permitted for hedging virtual export revenue without requiring physical peso delivery.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for matching foreign-currency loan and revenue structures.
Foreign-currency options (European-style) to hedge committed revenue when the banking counterparty is licensed by the SFC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration (Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March each year (for entities registered as of 1 January)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of 5% per month or fraction after 31 March; after six months, the chamber may cancel the registration and the company loses its legal status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (Estados Financieros) filed with the Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (and DIAN for tax purposes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March (attached to annual renewal; approved by shareholders' meeting within the same period)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file prevents renewal; delayed filing imposes indexation and fines of up to 10% of the renewal fee; prolonged failure can trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on a staggered schedule based on the last two digits of the NIT between 15 July and 15 August each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines range from 1% to 400% of unpaid tax; late filing fine of 5% of tax due plus interest; failure to file for three consecutive years leads to severe tax classification penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner confirmation (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June following the fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary fines of up to 4,000 UVT (approx USD 48,000) per year of non-compliance; potential criminal sanctions for money laundering concealment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for S.A.S. if total assets or gross income at year-end exceed 5,000 UVT (approx USD 60,000) or if more than 10 employees; also required for public-interest entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF/IFRS) as adopted for Groups 1, 2 and 3; all S.A.S. must apply the applicable NIIF framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO must be confirmed annually through DIAN's electronic channels by 30 June; shareholding transfers require register updating within one month; annual confirmation is independent of share transfer filings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Asociados)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva)
Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,500 (local compliance agent and virtual office)

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small-SAS progressive regime under Article 240(3) E.T.: 0% on first 10,200 UVT of net taxable income, 10% on next tranche up to 41,000 UVT...
